recipes.name: The Crispiest Sandwich inspired by They Kidnapped my Son on Christmas
ingredients: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast, butterfied
As needed freshly ground black pepper
instructions: for the Crispiest Sandwich
Preheat the oven to 375 °F
Cut the baguette in half and spread 2 tablespoons of mayonnaise over each of the cut halves. - ½ crusty baguette - 2 tbsp mayonnaise divided

Place the baguette, cut-side down, onto a small rimmed baking sheet. Top the baguette with another sheet tray to weigh it down, then toast in the preheat oven for 4-5 minutes or until golden brown and crispy.
Mix together the remaining mayonnaise with the mustard, then spread the mixture of both sides of the toasted baguette. - 1 tbsp mayonnaise divided - 2 tsp whole grain mustard

Layer the Panko Chicken, Baked Bacon strips, Fried Green Tomatoes, Fried Cheese slabs, and lettuce to assemble the sandwich. - 1 piece Panko Fried Chicken - 2 ½ Baked Bacon strips cooked - 2 ½ Fried Green Tomatoes - 1 ½ Fried Cheese slabs - 1 ½ Iceberg Lettuce leaves
Enjoy immediately.
for the Dredge
Combine the eggs and buttermilk in a medium bowl, whisk to combine and set aside. - 2 whole eggs - 1 ½ cup buttermilk

In a shallow rimmed plate or baking dish, whisk together the flour, salt, cayenne, paprika, pepper, onion powder, garlic powder, and white pepper. Set aside. - 1 ½ cup all purpose flour - 1 ½ tsp kosher salt - 1 tsp ground cayenne - 1 tsp smoked paprika - ½ tsp freshly ground black pepper - ¼ tsp onion powder - ¼ tsp garlic powder - ¼ tsp white pepper
In another shallow rimmed plate or baking dish, add the cornmeal, then set aside. - ½ cup fine cornmeal
In a final shallow rimmed plate or baking dish, add the breadcrumbs, then set aside. - 2 cup panko breadcrumbs
for the Panko Fried Chicken

Pat the chicken with paper towels, then season generously with salt and pepper. Set aside at room temperature for 25-30 minutes. - 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast butterfied - As needed kosher salt - As needed freshly ground black pepper
Meanwhile, preheat the oil in a large high-walled skillet to 375 °F. - 56 oz fry oil of choice
Dredge the chicken breasts in the flour mixture, the egg mixture, then finally, in the breadcrumbs. - for the Dredge

Working in batches, carefully add the dredged chicken breast to the fry oil and fry for 8-12 minutes (depending on the size and thickness of the chicken) or until cooked to an internal temperature of 165 °F and crisp.
Transfer the chicken to a paper towel-lined sheet tray and season immediately with a sprinkling of finishing salt. - As needed finishing salt
Set aside on a rack until ready to use.
for the Fried Green Tomatoes
Place the sliced tomatoes on a rack and season with salt. Let sit at room temperature for 25-30 minutes. - 3 ½ green tomatoes sliced 1/4 1/3 inch thick - As needed kosher salt
Meanwhile, preheat the oil in a large high-walled skillet to 350 °F. - 56 oz fry oil of choice
Pat the tomato slices dry using a paper towel, then dredge the slices first in the flour mixture, then in the egg mixture, and finally in the cornmeal. - Dredge
Fry the tomato slices until golden brown, about 4-5 minutes. Tranfer to a paper towel-lined plate.
Set aside on a rack until ready to use.
for the Fried Cheese
Cut the mozzarella into slabs about ⅓-½ inch thick and roughly the length of the sandwich. - ½ lb low moisture mozzarella
Dredge the cheese in the flour mixture, egg mixture, breadcrumbs, then back into the egg mixture and breadcrumbs for a double coat. - Dredge
Freeze the cheese slabs for 20 minutes before frying.
Meanwhile, preheat the oil in a large high-walled skillet to 375 °F. - 56 oz fry oil of choice
Add the partially frozen slabs to the preheated oil and fry for about 1-2 minutes or until golden brown and crispy.
Set aside on a rack until ready to use.
for the Baked Bacon
Preheat the oven to 375 °F with convection.
Line a large rimmed baking sheet with aluminum foil and place a grill rack into the sheet tray.
Place the strips of bacon onto the grill rack and transfer the baking sheet to the preheated oven. - ½ lb thick cut bacon
Bake the bacon for 18-24 minutes, flipping each slice halfway through the baking time, or until crisp and deeply browned.
